proposed_widenings.name: ignite_object
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell has an on-hit rider that starts a flammable object burning, but the closed spell effect vocabulary only supports damage or none.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.

notes: Encoded honestly as a one-phase activation for the ranged spell attack and tier-scaled fire damage. The object-ignition rider is preserved in description text but omitted from mechanics because the current surface/tracer lacks an ignition or burning effect.
